scenarios.title: The affected object's controller chooses among applicable replacement effects, and the rest are rechecked
decisions: A casts Diabolic Edict targeting B, tapping both Swamps; both players pass and Diabolic Edict resolves.
B sacrifices Darksteel Colossus, its only creature.
B, as the controller of the affected object, chooses Rest in Peace's replacement effect to apply first.

variants.label: rest-in-peace-first
variants.expected: Darksteel Colossus is exiled instead of going to the graveyard. Its own shuffle-into-library effect no longer applies and does nothing. Diabolic Edict is also exiled by Rest in Peace.

variants.label: colossus-first
variants.delta: B chooses Darksteel Colossus's own replacement effect to apply first.
variants.expected: Darksteel Colossus is shuffled into B's library instead of going to the graveyard; Rest in Peace no longer applies to it and does nothing. Diabolic Edict is still exiled.

variants.label: single-effect
variants.delta: Rest in Peace is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Only Darksteel Colossus's replacement effect applies, with no choice to make; it is shuffled into B's library. Diabolic Edict goes to A's graveyard.

scenarios.title: A self-replacement effect is applied before other replacement effects
decisions: A plays Mountain from hand as the land drop.
A casts Searing Blaze targeting B and Centaur Courser, tapping two Mountains; both players pass and Searing Blaze resolves.
No order is chosen: Searing Blaze's own landfall replacement is applied before Furnace of Rath's doubling.

variants.label: landfall
variants.expected: The landfall replacement makes the damage 3 to each, and Furnace of Rath doubles it: B takes 6 damage (14 life) and Centaur Courser takes 6 and dies.

variants.label: no-landfall
variants.delta: A does not play the Mountain, so no land entered under A's control this turn.
variants.expected: Searing Blaze deals 1 damage to each, doubled to 2: B is at 18 life and Centaur Courser (3/3) survives with 2 damage marked.

scenarios.forge_notes: In Forge the landfall condition is part of Searing Blaze's own damage amount (Count$Landfall), so the doubling applies to the final amount.

scenarios.title: A copy effect applying as an object enters the battlefield is applied before other replacement effects
decisions: A casts Rusted Sentinel, tapping four Forests; both players pass and it resolves.
No order is chosen: Essence of the Wild's copy effect is applied before Rusted Sentinel's enters-tapped effect.

variants.label: essence-present
variants.expected: Rusted Sentinel enters as a copy of Essence of the Wild (a 6/6 Avatar). Because the copy effect applied first, it has no 'enters tapped' ability and is untapped.

variants.label: essence-absent
variants.delta: Essence of the Wild is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Rusted Sentinel enters as itself (a 3/4 Golem) and its own effect makes it enter tapped.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge may apply Rusted Sentinel's enters-tapped replacement independently of the clone; the rules outcome is an untapped copy.

scenarios.title: An effect on an event contained in another event is applied after the containing event's effect
decisions: A casts Raise the Alarm, tapping both Plains; both players pass and it resolves.
Doubling Season's effect is applied to the token creation first; Essence of the Wild's copy effect is then applied to each token as it enters.

variants.label: both-effects
variants.expected: Doubling Season changes two tokens into four; each of the four tokens then enters as a copy of Essence of the Wild. A controls four 6/6 Essence of the Wild tokens (plus the original Essence of the Wild).

variants.label: no-essence
variants.delta: Essence of the Wild is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Doubling Season alone makes four tokens; they enter as four 1/1 white Soldier tokens.

variants.label: no-doubling
variants.delta: Doubling Season is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Raise the Alarm creates two tokens, and each enters as a copy of Essence of the Wild: two 6/6 Essence of the Wild tokens.

scenarios.forge_notes: The final board is the same whichever order Forge applies the two effects in; the scenario checks both effects take part.

scenarios.title: A replacement or prevention effect can become applicable because of a previous one
decisions: B casts Lightning Bolt targeting A, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Lightning Bolt resolves.

variants.label: cleric-enchanted
variants.expected: Pariah makes the 3 damage to A be dealt to Daunting Defender instead. That now triggers Daunting Defender's prevention, so 1 is prevented: Daunting Defender has 2 damage marked and survives; A stays at 20 life.

variants.label: bears-enchanted
variants.delta: Pariah is attached to Grizzly Bears instead of Daunting Defender.
variants.expected: Pariah redirects the 3 damage to Grizzly Bears, which is not a Cleric, so nothing is prevented; Grizzly Bears dies. A stays at 20 life.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge must re-run the replacement check on the redirected damage target for the second effect to apply.
